supersedes_pending_question_only.question: Whether the proposed EGC can be distinguished from existing current:south-indian, rather than merely from SICC.

existing_identity_comparison.locator: Section3.2, printed362/PDF6; Figure1 caption and SIC label, printed359/PDF3.
existing_identity_comparison.finding: SIC is the eastward southern subtropical-gyre flow near40S. EGC in the2018 study has a tropical setting and a different named scope.
existing_identity_comparison.decision_basis: Editorial inference from the two primary-source scope descriptions; neither paper is claimed to perform a direct EGC-versus-SIC alias test.

proposed_identity_basis.finding: The study identifies tropical EGC separately and treats it as a northern SICC continuation feeding HLC.
proposed_identity_basis.classification: Separately named current scope; no inferred alias or automatic parent link.

historical_scope_warning.finding: The paper notes conflicting EGC usage and reassigns some older northern Leeuwin inflow descriptions to central SICC.

prohibited_dimension_promotions: Grand2015 describes gyre latitude limits; these are not SIC path endpoints.
The2800km separation of Grand2015 cruise tracks is not a current length.
Wijeratne2018 model-section latitude/depth context is not a paired current width or whole-current footprint.
